# chainguard_image_overlay (Resource)

A named, reusable Custom Assembly overlay, attached to image repos with chainguard_image_overlay_binding.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "chainguard_group" "example" {
  name = "example-group"
}

# A reusable Custom Assembly overlay, owned by a group. Attach it to
# image repos with chainguard_image_overlay_binding.
resource "chainguard_image_overlay" "example" {
  parent_id = chainguard_group.example.id
  name      = "debug-tools"
  packages  = ["curl", "jq"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of this overlay, unique among the group's overlays.
- `packages` (List of String) Packages to append to images the overlay is bound to. At least one is required.
- `parent_id` (String) The IAM group that owns the overlay.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The UIDP of this overlay.
